steps.label: NetworkPolicy
steps.sub: applied by kubectl, outside the chart

eyebrow: DB access, locked to one label
code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: grain-ingest-db-access
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ingest
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
    - to:
        - ipBlock: { cidr: 10.20.2.0/24 }
      ports: [{ protocol: TCP, port: 1433 }]
caption: Deliberately kept outside the grain-ingest Helm chart's release cadence.

eyebrow: The convention this design depends on
code:
Deployment pod labels:  app: ingest
NetworkPolicy selector: app: ingest

-- two independently-versioned files, agreeing by convention.
caption: Both reviewed together now, so they start out in sync.
